caption: A desk fan is switched on next to a loose stack of papers, and the top sheets lift and scatter across the desk and floor.

sa.check: A desk fan stands next to a loose stack of papers.
Sheets scatter across the desk and floor.
The switch comes first, then the lift, then the scatter.

pc.expect: Sheets move only after the fan starts.
pc.fail: Sheets fly before the fan is on; or the fan runs and nothing moves; or sheets keep flying after the fan is off.

pc.expect: Sheets fly away from the fan.
pc.fail: They fly toward the fan; or sideways across the airflow; or straight up and hover.

pc.expect: The top sheets go first and the bottom sheets stay longer.
pc.fail: Bottom sheets fly first; or the whole stack lifts as one; or sheets restack themselves.

pc.expect: Sheets fall to the desk or floor and settle.
pc.fail: They hang; or rise to the ceiling; or float.

pc.expect: The sheets keep their number and the fan stays one fan.
pc.fail: Sheets multiply; or vanish; or the fan duplicates.

pc.expect: The fan, the desk and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The fan changes colour; or the desk rearranges; or the papers change printing.
